jobs_results.description:
Company Description
Tribe AI is a modern AI-native consultancy powered by engineers, scientists, and researchers from companies like Google, Amazon, Meta, and OpenAI. Our mission is to help enterprises rearchitect their business with AI—turning cutting-edge model capability into production systems that create real value. We partner with organizations to solve their hardest problems by building custom AI solutions with the best talent in the business.


About the Role
As an AI Solutions Architect at Tribe AI, you’ll sit at the intersection of frontier AI capability and enterprise reality. You’ll serve as the technical bridge between our clients and internal AI experts—partnering closely with General Managers (Enterprise AEs) to understand customer needs, define high-impact AI use cases, and architect tailored solutions that can actually ship.



This is not a “demo-only” role. You’ll lead technical discovery, make architectural tradeoffs, and build clarity in ambiguous environments—often pressure-testing ideas through rapid prototypes. You’ll also collaborate closely with frontier model labs like OpenAI and Anthropic (e.g., working sessions/calls with their Applied AI / solutions teams) to unblock constraints, validate approaches, and stay close to emerging capabilities.


Key responsibilities:

‍Lead technical discovery with customers to understand workflows, constraints, data realities, and success criteria—and translate that into a clear technical plan.
Architect end-to-end AI systems (GenAI + traditional ML when needed), spanning data ingestion, retrieval, orchestration, evaluation, deployment, and UX.
Design and deliver rapid prototypes that make abstract ideas concrete and de-risk key decisions (cost/latency/reliability, integration feasibility, quality thresholds).
Develop reference architectures and technical frameworks that demonstrate what’s possible with current and emerging AI technologies.
Guide clients through the AI landscape—capabilities, limitations, tradeoffs, and what it takes to operate AI systems in production over time.
Partner with sales teams to translate technical concepts into clear value propositions, proposals, business cases, and technical presentations.
Define technical requirements and scalable architecture patterns for production-grade systems (security, governance, observability, evaluation, and reliability).
Collaborate with fulfillment to ensure solutions align with customer needs and leverage Tribe AI’s capabilities—and help create smooth handoffs from pre-sales to delivery.
Stay current on frontier developments, bringing in SMEs from the Tribe network and collaborating with partners (including OpenAI/Anthropic) to keep customers ahead of the curve.
Act as a trusted advisor to technical and executive stakeholders navigating AI implementation and adoption challenges.

About You

5+ years leading technical workstreams; experience as a Solutions Architect, or a similar customer-facing technical role in the AI, cloud, data platform, or backend infrastructure space.
Strong customer-facing instincts: you can run discovery, ask the right questions, and turn ambiguity into clear architecture and next steps.
Experience scoping projects and estimating effort to build end-to-end applications (including assumptions, risks, milestones, and dependencies).
Strong fluency in Generative AI and the evolving LLM ecosystem and you’ve built or consulted on AI/GenAI systems in production.
Expertise with production cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP) and modern deployment patterns.
Systems thinker who can balance speed and rigor: you’re comfortable making tradeoffs and explaining them to both engineers and execs.
Excellent communication skills (written + verbal): you can make complex technical concepts feel simple and actionable.

Why Join Us

Work at the frontier: collaborate closely with OpenAI and Anthropic teams as part of real customer work—staying close to what’s emerging and what’s actually deployable.
High-leverage, end-to-end ownership: shape what gets built and how—from first conversation through architecture, prototypes, and production path.
Diverse, cutting-edge projects across industries—solving problems that rarely have playbooks.
Build real systems: production-bound architectures, real constraints, real impact (not “innovation theater”).
Learn fast in a high-talent, low-bureaucracy environment where clarity and execution matter.
Shape the future of enterprise AI implementation alongside leaders who care deeply about excellence and outcomes.

Travel Requirements

~1X per month traveling to see clients and partners

Benefits

Competitive salary
Equity package
Health insurance
Unlimited Vacation time

Description

The Enterprise Microsoft Copilot Studio, Copilot Cowork, and Claude Cowork Architect will help the organization safely enable Microsoft Copilot Studio, Copilot Cowork, Claude Cowork (Anthropic), Copilot agents, and related agentic AI capabilities.

This role will define the standards, design patterns, guardrails, and solution design practices needed to support secure, compliant, scalable, and policy-aligned adoption across the enterprise.

The architect will partner with enterprise architecture, security, risk, compliance, privacy, data governance, platform, engineering, workforce technology, and business teams to ensure Copilot-based and Claude-based solutions are designed responsibly and operated effectively.

This is a hands-on architecture leadership role focused on enabling business value while protecting enterprise data, enforcing governance expectations, and reducing delivery risk across a multi-vendor agentic AI landscape.

	Define integration patterns across Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Dataverse, SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, Microsoft Graph, Anthropic Claude, APIs, enterprise applications, workflow platforms, and knowledge repositories.

	Develop patterns for observability, audit trails, task execution visibility, quality evaluation, prompt testing, incident response, and continuous improvement.

	Evaluate emerging Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Copilot Cowork, Claude Cowork, Power Platform, Azure AI, Agent 365, and agentic AI capabilities for enterprise applicability.

	Eight or more years of experience in enterprise architecture, solution architecture, platform architecture, software engineering, cloud engineering, or technology delivery.

	Experience designing and governing enterprise solutions across Microsoft 365, Power Platform, cloud, SaaS, data, integration, and enterprise application environments.

	Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Copilot Cowork, Claude Cowork, Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility, Power Platform, Power Automate, Dataverse, Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, Azure services, or comparable AI and automation platforms.

DESCRIPTION
Application deadline: Nov 1, 2026



Amazon Web Services (AWS) is proud to be the pioneer and widely recognised leader in Cloud Computing. Our web services provide IT infrastructure in-the-cloud that is used by hundreds of thousands of developers and businesses around the world, ranging from start-ups to leading web companies to Global 500 companies in industries such as financial services, pharmaceuticals, and manufacturing.



AWS Specialist Solutions Architects (SSAs) are technologists with deep domain-specific expertise, able to address advanced concepts and feature designs. As part of the AWS sales organization, SSAs work with customers who have complex challenges that require expert-level knowledge to solve. SSAs craft scalable, flexible, and resilient technical architectures that address those challenges. This might involve guiding customers as they refactor an application or designing entirely new cloud-based systems. Do you enjoy solving novel and unique technical challenges for customers? Become an AWS Specialist SA!



The Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) is part of AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS), which is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. We work backwards from our customer’s most complex and business critical problems to build and execute go-to-market plans that turn AWS ideas into multi-billion-dollar businesses. WWSO teams include business development, specialist and technical solutions architecture. As part of WWSO, you'll provide expertise across the entire life cycle of an AWS customer initiative, from developing ideas for new services to accelerating the adoption of established businesses. We pride ourselves on thinking big, delivering exceptional results for our customers, and working across AWS as #OneTeam.

Represent the voice of the customer; bring customer feedback to product teams to influence feature development and future product roadmap.Provide advanced technical knowledge to your domain aligned GTM teams to unblock our customers’ largest and most critical business challenges.Act as a thought leader sharing best practices through forums such as AWS blogs, whitepapers, reference architectures and public-speaking events such as AWS Summit, AWS re: Invent, etc.Partner with Business Development teams to define the technical components of best in class GTM concepts, solutions, and initiatives.Develop and support an AWS internal community of technical subject matter experts worldwide. AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.



Inclusive Team Culture



AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.



Mentorship & Career Growth



We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.




Work/Life Balance



We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

job_highlights.title: Responsibilities
items: In this highly visible role, you will help architect, develop, and operationalize AI‑driven analytics solutions that transform AMD’s end‑to‑end supply chain
You will work across planning, logistics, inventory, transformation, and factory operations to turn complex challenges into actionable insights and autonomous decisioning
This is a senior individual-contributor role with future growth into people leadership, supporting the rapid expansion of AI capabilities within Supply Chain Transformation
You thrive in dynamic, “gray‑area” environments and bring a balanced blend of technical depth, architectural thinking, and strong communication skills
You are comfortable managing shifting priorities, collaborating across functions, and working with global partners across time zones
You naturally provide structure and clarity, can manage upward, and enjoy enabling others as AI capabilities scale

Design, build, and deploy AI/ML models and advanced analytics that improve planning, inventory, logistics, network optimization, and S&OP, while architecting scalable data and analytics solutions that integrate seamlessly with enterprise platforms and supply chain systems

Develop and operationalize AI agents that continuously monitor supply chain signals, surface proactive insights, recommend actions, and automate decision workflows to enable a more autonomous supply chain environment

Translate ambiguous and complex supply chain problems into structured, data-driven solutions by performing exploratory analysis, scenario modeling, root‑cause investigations, and optimization across large datasets

Create high‑quality dashboards, semantic models, and KPI frameworks in Power BI; enable search‑driven and natural‑language analytics through ThoughtSpot; and establish best practices for visualization and data storytelling

Partner closely with data engineering teams to ensure reliable, well‑modeled datasets, while supporting pipeline development, feature engineering, and model deployment to production with an emphasis on scalability, explainability, and maintainability

Collaborate across Supply Chain, IT, and Transformation teams to align analytics initiatives with business priorities; communicate insights effectively to technical and non‑technical audiences; mentor junior contributors; and operate fluidly in a global, fast‑changing environment requiring flexibility across time zones

jobs_results.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. And we’re looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don’t shy away from humanity’s challenges but are determined to help solve them.

 

AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go-to-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward.

 


THE ROLE:   

In this highly visible role, you will help architect, develop, and operationalize AI‑driven analytics solutions that transform AMD’s end‑to‑end supply chain. You will work across planning, logistics, inventory, transformation, and factory operations to turn complex challenges into actionable insights and autonomous decisioning.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with future growth into people leadership, supporting the rapid expansion of AI capabilities within Supply Chain Transformation. You’ll partner globally across teams, influence technical and architectural decisions, and help drive clarity in a fast‑moving, ambiguous environment.

 

THE PERSON:   

You thrive in dynamic, “gray‑area” environments and bring a balanced blend of technical depth, architectural thinking, and strong communication skills. You are comfortable managing shifting priorities, collaborating across functions, and working with global partners across time zones. You naturally provide structure and clarity, can manage upward, and enjoy enabling others as AI capabilities scale.   

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:   

Design, build, and deploy AI/ML models and advanced analytics that improve planning, inventory, logistics, network optimization, and S&OP, while architecting scalable data and analytics solutions that integrate seamlessly with enterprise platforms and supply chain systems.Develop and operationalize AI agents that continuously monitor supply chain signals, surface proactive insights, recommend actions, and automate decision workflows to enable a more autonomous supply chain environment.Translate ambiguous and complex supply chain problems into structured, data-driven solutions by performing exploratory analysis, scenario modeling, root‑cause investigations, and optimization across large datasets.Create high‑quality dashboards, semantic models, and KPI frameworks in Power BI; enable search‑driven and natural‑language analytics through ThoughtSpot; and establish best practices for visualization and data storytelling.Partner closely with data engineering teams to ensure reliable, well‑modeled datasets, while supporting pipeline development, feature engineering, and model deployment to production with an emphasis on scalability, explainability, and maintainability.Collaborate across Supply Chain, IT, and Transformation teams to align analytics initiatives with business priorities; communicate insights effectively to technical and non‑technical audiences; mentor junior contributors; and operate fluidly in a global, fast‑changing environment requiring flexibility across time zones. 

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:  

Expertise in Python and/or R, with hands‑on experience building and deploying AI/ML models, generative solutions, or AI agents that automate insights, recommendations, or actions.Strong capability in Power BI (data modeling, DAX, semantic layer design) and familiarity with ThoughtSpot or similar search/NLQ analytics tools.Demonstrated ability to architect scalable data and analytics solutions, integrating models, pipelines, and AI agents with enterprise platforms and supply chain systems.Background applying analytics, AI, or data science within planning, logistics, inventory, network optimization, S&OP, or other supply‑chain‑relevant workflows.Experience with feature engineering, production pipelines, and deploying models/agents into repeatable, maintainable operating environments.Knowledge of optimization techniques (linear programming, heuristics) and experience integrating analytics with ERP systems such as SAP.Exposure to LLMs, prompt engineering, and enterprise agent frameworks, with the ability to design solutions that are explainable and user‑friendly.Ability to work effectively in global teams, manage shifting priorities, collaborate across functions, and communicate clearly with leadership and technical partners.Prior experience in a semiconductor supply chain is a plus but not required. 

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:   

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in data science, Engineering, Operations Research, Supply Chain, Computer Science, or related field.

jobs_results.title: AI Solutions Architect
jobs_results.description:
Firm Overview



Providence Equity Partners L.L.C. is a leading middle-market private equity firm with deep sector expertise in media, communications and education focused on North America and Europe. Providence looks to invest in businesses that are benefiting from the long-term growth trends around experiences, learning, and connectivity by partnering with exceptional management teams to build enduring, scaled companies. Founded in 1989 in Providence, Rhode Island, the firm has invested over $40 billion across more than 180 portfolio companies with a transatlantic investment team based primarily in London, New York and Boston. Through disciplined portfolio construction, prudent risk management and a collaborative culture, the firm seeks to deliver strong results across market cycles. To learn more, please visit www.provequity.com.





Position Overview
The AI Solutions Architect is responsible for applying AI technologies to solve high-value business problems across PEP and its portfolio companies. This role will join the Firm's Portfolio Operations team and partners with IT, Investment, Finance, Operations, and other business teams to understand business needs, identify where AI can meaningfully improve outcomes, and translate those opportunities into practical, secure, and scalable solutions.



The AI Solutions Architect will lead the evaluation, configuration, integration, and implementation of AI-enabled solutions using commercially available AI models, platforms, and enterprise technologies. The role will guide initiatives from opportunity identification and solution design through implementation, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement. Success in this role requires strong technical fluency, business judgment, and the ability to translate business needs into practical solutions while ensuring appropriate security, privacy, governance, and responsible AI controls.



Responsibilities 
The AI Solutions Architect will be responsible for the following:

Partner with IT, Investment, Finance, Operations, and other business teams to understand business processes, identify high-value opportunities for AI, and prioritize initiatives based on business value, feasibility, risk, and scalability.

Translate business needs into practical AI-enabled solutions by evaluating available technologies and determining how existing AI tools, platforms, and enterprise capabilities can be applied to improve productivity, decision-making, operational effectiveness, or financial outcomes.

Design solution approaches that leverage existing AI capabilities, including generative AI platforms, intelligent agents, enterprise search, workflow automation, and other commercially available technologies.

Leverage current, commercially available AI solutions within existing business processes and enterprise systems, including Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Slack, Workday, DealCloud, and other firm and portfolio company platforms to solve prioritized business cases. Where an existing solution is not the best fit, recommend alternative AI approaches.

Evaluate AI models, platforms, applications, and third-party solutions and make recommendations based on business requirements, functionality, ease of implementation, integration needs, cost, security, scalability, and operational risk.

Determine the appropriate solution approach, including when to leverage an existing enterprise capability, configure a commercial AI product, integrate multiple technologies, or use a non-AI solution when it better addresses the business need.

Lead AI initiatives from business problem definition through implementation and adoption, coordinating solution design, configuration, integration, testing, stakeholder engagement, rollout, monitoring, and ongoing enhancement.

Establish reusable solution patterns, implementation approaches, and playbooks that enable successful AI use cases to be replicated and scaled across business functions and portfolio companies.

Partner with Technology and Legal teams to incorporate security, privacy, governance, regulatory, and responsible AI requirements into the selection, configuration, integration, and use of AI solutions.

Define and monitor measures of solution effectiveness and business impact, including adoption, productivity improvement, financial value, and return on investment, and use results to guide enhancements and future priorities.



In addition to the outlined responsibilities, you will be expected to handle ad hoc requests as they arise. This job description is not exhaustive and may not encompass all aspects of the role, as the needs of the business are continually evolving. Flexibility and adaptability are essential for success in this dynamic position.





Qualifications
The successful candidate will have a demonstrated record of success, a positive professional reputation, and the ability to exercise sound judgment and accountability. In addition, the successful candidate should have:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, Business Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

8+ years of relevant professional experience in technology solutions, enterprise applications, digital transformation, technology consulting, systems integration, software solutions, product management. engineering management or a related field, with recent professional experience focused on applying AI technologies to business problems and implementing AI-enabled solutions.

Demonstrated experience translating business requirements into technology solutions and leading initiatives from problem definition and solution evaluation through implementation, adoption, and ongoing improvement.

Experience partnering directly with business stakeholders to understand workflows, identify opportunities for improvement, evaluate technology options, and implement solutions that deliver measurable business value.

Strong practical knowledge of generative AI technologies, commercially available AI platforms, and enterprise AI capabilities, including an understanding of their appropriate uses, limitations, and risks.

Experience applying capabilities such as generative AI, intelligent agents, enterprise search, retrieval-augmented generation, workflow automation, and AI-enabled productivity tools to business processes and use cases.

Experience configuring and integrating technology solutions with enterprise applications, APIs, business systems, structured and unstructured data sources, and workflow platforms.

Strong understanding of enterprise technology environments and the ability to assess how AI solutions can be incorporated into existing systems and business processes.

Demonstrated ability to evaluate third-party technologies and make recommendations regarding buy, configure, integrate, or alternative solution approaches based on business value, technical fit, scalability, cost, security, and risk.

Working knowledge of data security, privacy, access controls, AI governance, and responsible AI principles, with the ability to incorporate these considerations into technology selection and implementation.

Strong analytical and business problem-solving skills, including the ability to determine whether AI is an appropriate solution and identify simpler technology or process alternatives when appropriate.

Ability to independently lead complex, cross-functional initiatives, establish priorities, influence technical and non-technical stakeholders, and communicate AI capabilities, limitations, risks, and trade-offs clearly.

Sufficient technical fluency to work effectively with Technology teams, vendors, and solution providers and to understand integration requirements, APIs, data flows, system dependencies, and implementation considerations.



Requirements
We are committed to creating a workplace that fosters a collegial, inclusive, and collaborative environment As part of the Providence team, it's important that we hire candidates that align and exhibit our values:

Demonstrated ability to work effectively across teams, actively contribute ideas, and build strong, trustbased relationships to achieve shared goals and drive collective success.

Proven track record of taking accountability for outcomes, following through on commitments, and acting with honesty, transparency, and ethical judgment in all situations.

Commitment to fostering a positive, engaging workplace culture by supporting colleagues, contributing to a sense of belonging, and modeling behaviors that reflect and strengthen our organizational values.

Ability to work respectfully with individuals of diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, demonstrating empathy, fairness, and a commitment to inclusive practices in everyday interactions and decisionmaking.



This role may periodically require work outside standard business hours to meet business needs and deadlines. Performance is measured by results, quality of work, and timely delivery; employees are expected to use sound judgment regarding after-hours support and communicate proactively when unavailable.



This position is primarily performed in a professional office environment and involves prolonged computer use, regular communication by phone/video/email, attendance at meetings, and use of standard office equipment. Occasional business travel may be required based on business needs.





Providence Equity Partners L.L.C. (the "Firm") is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practice laws. The Firm strictly prohibits and will not tolerate, condone or allow discrimination, harassment or retaliation with respect to any Supervised Person or applicant for employment in matters of hiring (or failure or refusal to hire), promotion, transfer, disciplinary actions, assignments, working conditions, termination, compensation, fringe benefits or other terms and conditions of employment on the basis of characteristics protected by federal, state, or local law, as may be applicable, such as race, color, religion, creed, age, national origin, ancestry, alienage or citizenship status, actual or perceived sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding or other related medical conditions), actual or perceived gender (including sex stereotyping, gender identity, gender expression, other gender-related characteristic, or transgender status), actual or perceived sexual orientation, disability (including physical disability or mental disability), medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, employment or unemployment status, credit history, familial status, partnership status, caregiver status, sexual and reproductive health decision-making, domestic victim status, or marital status, pay or other compensation history, or height and weight. All employees are prohibited from engaging in unlawful discrimination, harassment, bullying, or retaliation.

Any unsolicited resume or candidate information sent to the Firm or any of its employees-whether submitted via email, postal mail, online platforms, or through any other means-by a third-party recruiting agency lacking a current signed agreement will be deemed the property of the Firm. In such circumstances, no implied contract or obligation shall be created, and the Firm expressly reserves the right to contact, engage, or hire any such candidate without any financial or other obligation to the submitting agency.
